CustomField.label: Delta Tracking Field API Name
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of the field PrivacyGuard uses to track Delta or Once masking state for each record.
CustomField.description: Required for Run_Mode__c = Delta or Once. API name of a field on the target object that the framework stamps on every successful masking update: a DateTime field for Delta mode (compared against LastModifiedDate), or a Checkbox field for Once mode (a simple one-time flag). The field type must match the selected Run_Mode__c or the job will fail with a clear error rather than a cryptic SOQL type mismatch.
